terms.gloss: corridor, a passage between two walls
terms.comment: Used of the long airport corridors in Libellus I.

terms.gloss: a walk planted with trees, beside a house
terms.comment: Traupman’s “corridor, hallway”, but in Plautus and Gellius an outdoor walk among trees (Lewis & Short: ante- and post-classical for ambulātiō).

sources: Lewis & Short: andron
